lineage: render check 2026-09-29 (docs/engine/rendercheck/00-PLAN.md section 9: 'border-spacing gaps are filled by the cell paint'; the render check's authors rebuilt scorecards from positioned divs to avoid it)
notes: border-collapse: separate with a border-spacing. A PowerPoint table has no cell spacing, so before this family the
native table's cells ran over the gaps and a scorecard lost its white lines. Now every gap between cells that paint
(a fill, a gradient, a border) is an empty, unfilled, borderless spacer row or column of the native table, and the
table's edge moves to the painted cells' edge: what shows through a gap is the table's surface or the slide, as in
the browser (row, row-group and column backgrounds paint only under cells in separate mode - measured on Edge).
PowerPoint lays out no row or column under 2 pt (2.667 px, measured through COM): a gap from 1 pt to 2 pt is drawn
2.667 px, the cells beside it giving up the difference (info); a gap under 1 pt is closed (warn).
A scorecard: border-spacing 2px 4px, a navy header, tinted body cells, a 'Growth' rowspan. 9 x 9 physical: spacer
rows 1, 3, 5, 7 (4 px, exact) and spacer columns 1, 3, 5, 7 (2 px widened to 2.667 px, each neighbour 0.333 px
narrower). 'Growth' is merged across physical rows 2-4, the spacer row between its two rows included.
B cards: border-spacing 6px on the table's own rounded, stroked F3F5F9 surface (the 1 shape); 1 px C9D2DF cell
borders, a colspan header, a rowspan cell with a 4 px left accent. 5 x 5 physical, grid lines half the widest
border inside each band (PowerPoint strokes a cell rule centred on its grid line). PowerPoint draws a lower cell's
lnT / a right cell's lnL on an interior line only where the neighbour is a merge continuation (measured): so a
cell's top and left rules move onto the spacer cells above and to its left as lnB / lnR, and the spacer cells
under the header's continuation columns carry its bottom rule as lnT (beside the rowspan's continuation rows, lnL).
The header's 1 px left rule shares column 0's line with the accent's 4 px one: it lands 1.5 px inside the cell.
C hairline: border-spacing 1px between filled cells - under 1 pt, closed: the one warn below. The gate's only
table defect is this closed 1 px line through the navy column (818 px2).
D plain: the default 2 px spacing around cells that paint nothing - invisible gaps, no spacer, the table as before.
text 1: the title. Cell text is inside the tables and not counted.
